sources.title: Top CNC Training Institute in Bangalore - Justdial
Rite CNC CAD & CAM Training Centre

output.findings:
Finding specific, direct comparisons of five distinct, reputable CNC/VMC training institutes in Bangalore is challenging due to the fragmented nature of local training providers, many of which appear primarily as directory listings. Based on available data, the prominent institutes often cited in the region include Rite CNC, CADPOINT, Techsys, Alined Technologies, and Upskill Labs.

Rite CNC is a well-established provider, active since 2008, focusing on CAD/CAM and CNC programming (Mill and Lathe). They emphasize practical industry solutions and claim to have trained over 2,500 students. Their curriculum includes Mastercam training, cycle time optimization, and tool path generation for 3/4/5 axis machining, catering to the automobile and aerospace sectors.

Other institutes like CADPOINT, Techsys, and Alined Technologies are frequently listed in professional training directories for Bangalore. These centers typically offer a mix of software-based training (CAD/CAM) and practical machine operation training. However, detailed curriculum comparisons are limited, and prospective students are generally advised to verify current lab equipment, trainer certifications, and placement assistance records directly with each facility.

returns very little usable text, do not retry; move on.

distiller or formatter does that. If the question cannot be answered
from the web within your budget, return `"findings": "(not found)"`
and let the next node decide.
